arguments.code:
cart_access_token = cart_access_token  # from previous run
cart_items = cart['cart_items']
cart_product_ids = {i['product_id'] for i in cart_items}
wish_items = wish
wish_product_ids = {i['product_id'] for i in wish_items}
print('cart_product_ids:', cart_product_ids)
print('wish_product_ids:', wish_product_ids)
print('overlap:', cart_product_ids & wish_product_ids)

# home address
addrs_home = [a for a in addrs if a['name'].lower()=='home']
print('home_addresses:', addrs_home)
home_address_id = addrs_home[0]['address_id']
print('home_address_id:', home_address_id)

# choose payment card with latest expiry year/month among listed
payment_cards = apis.amazon.show_payment_cards(access_token=cart_access_token)
for pc in payment_cards:
    pc['expiry_tuple'] = (pc['expiry_year'], pc['expiry_month'])
latest_pc = max(payment_cards, key=lambda x: (x['expiry_year'], x['expiry_month']))
print('payment_cards:', [{'payment_card_id':pc['payment_card_id'],'card_name':pc['card_name'],'expiry_year':pc['expiry_year'],'expiry_month':pc['expiry_month']} for pc in payment_cards])
print('latest_pc_selected:', latest_pc)
payment_card_id = latest_pc['payment_card_id']
print('payment_card_id:', payment_card_id)

wish_items = wish
cart_items = cart['cart_items']
expected_quantities = {i['product_id']: int(i['quantity']) for i in cart_items}
for wi in wish_items:
    expected_quantities[wi['product_id']] = expected_quantities.get(wi['product_id'], 0) + int(wi['quantity'])
print('expected_unique_products:', len(expected_quantities))
print('expected_quantities:', expected_quantities)
print('expected_total_quantity:', sum(expected_quantities.values()))

# Move every wish list item into the cart with its quantity
for wi in wish_items:
    pid = wi['product_id']
    qty = int(wi['quantity'])
    # Only move if qty>=1
    if qty >= 1:
        res_move = apis.amazon.move_product_from_wish_list_to_cart(product_id=pid, quantity=qty, access_token=cart_access_token)
        print('moved_to_cart', pid, 'qty', qty, '->', res_move)

# Place order for all items currently in the cart, shipped to Home
order_res = apis.amazon.place_order(payment_card_id=payment_card_id, address_id=home_address_id, access_token=cart_access_token)
print('order_res:', order_res)
order_id = order_res['order_id']
print('order_id:', order_id)
